full_prompt_en: A square photographic double exposure shows a right facing human profile whose upper silhouette is filled with a glowing orange sunset and dark tree shapes. The person occupies the left and central part of the frame against a smooth light gray background that stays almost empty on the right. Loose dark hair gathers at the back of the head, with a few strands extending toward the left. The nose, lips, chin, and neck form a clear dark outer contour facing right. Below the cheek, the shoulders and coat remain nearly black navy, with faint fabric folds and a raised collar visible near the lower left. Inside the forehead, crown, and upper cheek, a second landscape image appears: a strip of saturated red orange sky fades toward a yellow bright area near the upper right of the head. Black tree silhouettes line the lower edge of this inner scene, and a dark low mountain shape follows the face contour near the nose. A few cloud bands cross the warm field, their edges soft rather than sharply cut. The photographic layers meet unevenly around the hairline and jaw; some areas of the outer subject dissolve into the landscape while the lower body keeps its solid dark value. The surrounding gray studio field has no objects, lettering, or visible horizon of its own. Light from the inner sunset acts as the main luminous source, set against the unlit lower silhouette and the restrained outer background. The overall composition is sparse and contemplative, using the boundary of one dark profile to contain a vivid, expansive moment of light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形摄影双重曝光呈现一张朝右的侧面剪影，其上半部填入发亮的橙色落日与深色树影。人物占据画面左侧和中央，背景是平滑浅灰色，右侧几乎全空。松散深发聚在后脑，几缕发丝伸向左方。鼻、唇、下巴和颈形成朝右清楚的深色外轮廓。面颊以下，肩膀与外套保持近乎黑蓝色，下左方附近可见细微布褶和竖起的衣领。额头、头顶和上面颊内部出现第二层风景图像：一带饱和红橙天空朝头部右上附近的明黄区域渐变。黑色树影排在内景下缘，深暗的低山形状沿鼻旁的脸部轮廓延续。几道云带横过暖色区域，边缘柔和而非锐利切割。摄影图层在发际线和下颌周围不均匀地相接；部分外层人物溶进风景，下方身体则保持坚实暗值。四周灰色影棚色场自身没有物件、字样或可见地平线。内部落日的光成为主要发光来源，对照未受光的下部剪影和克制的外侧背景。整体构图稀疏而沉思，以一张深色侧脸的边界容纳鲜烈、开阔的光。
style_prompt_en: Double exposure photography places a saturated warm scene within a crisp near black silhouette against a broad pale neutral field. Deep navy and charcoal hold the lower value mass, while red orange and golden yellow flare only inside the upper enclosed region. Internal layers merge through soft transparent transitions; the outer contour stays strong enough to remain immediately readable. Thin dark branching marks and low dark bands divide the warm area without erasing its glow. A nearly empty cool background provides generous negative space and increases the visual intensity of the contained color. Texture is fine and photographic, with smooth gray outer tone and slightly grainier dark passages. The apparent light is strongest inside the overlapping exposure, leaving the exterior unlit and quiet. The overall effect is reflective and graphic, joining precise silhouette with atmospheric color to suggest a larger space inside a compact form.
style_prompt_zh: 双重曝光摄影把一处饱和暖色场安放在清楚的近黑剪影内部，外面是宽阔浅中性色场。深海军蓝与炭色支撑下部明度体块，红橙和金黄只在上方封闭区域内闪亮。内部图层经柔软半透明过渡相融，外轮廓仍足够强烈，可立即辨认。纤细深色分叉痕和低矮暗带分割暖色区域，却不抹去光晕。几乎空白的冷色背景提供宽裕留白，增加被包裹色彩的视觉强度。肌理细腻而富有摄影感，外侧灰调平滑，较深部分略带颗粒。表面上的光最强处位于重叠曝光内部，外侧仍未受光而安静。整体效果沉思而图形化，把精确剪影与大气色彩结合，仿佛让紧凑形状内部藏着更宽阔空间。
theme_en: A profile silhouette filled with orange sunset and dark trees
theme_zh: 侧面剪影内部填着橙色落日和深色树影
name: Silhouette
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
